note: Observer-band pair-behaviour stage. Consumes lower-stage density/structure/volatility descriptors plus apparatus context and predicts phase separation, layer order, and the evaporated fraction for that context. It is an illustrative portable response surface fitted to a generic open-surface still-air transfer panel; it does not read pentane density, vapour pressure, boiling point, colour, or evaporation from a runtime reference. The emitted uncertainty and validation gap are mandatory. Replacing this compact response surface with a wider learned liquid-pair panel remains tracked in ROADMAP.md.
